post_outcome_disclosure: This analysis was conceived after Phase-5 test outcomes were opened. It can generate a hypothesis but cannot rescue or amend the Phase-5 confirmatory claim.
changed_estimand: For each target and calibration mask, fit the mean over train prompts of absolute finite-effect target loss.
retained_from_phase5: candidate masks and ten candidate pools
selection_policies: minimum predicted expected absolute target loss
minimum predicted expected absolute target loss plus 0.02 per ablated head
primary_descriptive_comparison: At 160 measurements, compare the all-pairs direct-risk selector with the all-pairs mean-effect selector using paired test-prompt by candidate-pool differences.
sensitivity_intervals: ordered IO-subject name-pair cluster by candidate pool
unordered IO-subject name-pair cluster by candidate pool
claim_rule: No result from this file is confirmatory because the analysis is post-outcome.

bounded_posthoc_screen.basis: intercept plus 13 head indicators plus all 78 distinct head-pair products
bounded_posthoc_screen.ridge_tuning: none; retain the Phase-5 ridge value
bounded_posthoc_screen.capacity_matched_control: Fit the same 92-column basis to mean train-prompt effect and select by absolute predicted target error.
bounded_posthoc_screen.purpose: Check whether the coarse group-pair basis is the apparent bottleneck.
